boundaries.description: Pure types, scoring, claim state machine. Leaf package: zero workspace imports, zero external dependencies.

Configuration loading and exclude pattern merging. Leaf package: zero workspace imports. Includes claimTypes validation, RuleDef.enabled handling, picomatch glob compilation, and indexing.sqlite.busyTimeout config key.

SQLite persistence layer. Imports viewer-core for shared types (OQ-1 resolution). C2 store: only designated writers may import this package. Includes embeddings table, file_hashes table, schema_migrations table, versioned migration runner, configurable PRAGMAs, busy_timeout PRAGMA, deleteFtsForFile on SnapshotTxn.

File discovery, extraction (TS, JSON, Python, Rust, Go, Java), TS language service adapter, import resolution, git mining, subsystem inference, claim generation. C2 writer: may import viewer-store. Includes optional ONNX Runtime embedding, worker-thread pool, incremental re-indexing, global symbol map, secret scrubbing, grammar checksums, Java visitor, picomatch glob matching, path relativization, batch writer, incremental FTS, rename detection.

Structured query operations and retrieval pipeline. Imports viewer-core ONLY. NEVER imports viewer-store; consumes structural ReadHandle interfaces satisfied by shape at composition root. PipelineReadHandle includes optional semanticSearch; ResultEnvelope includes optional extractionQuality field; suggestedNextCalls are result-dependent.

Verification engine, rules engine, on-demand claims. Imports viewer-core and viewer-retrieval. C2 writer: may import viewer-store at composition boundary only (structural handle pattern, not direct source import).

Composition root, MCP server, CLI, feedback, rule authoring. Imports all packages. The single place where real viewer-store handles are bound to retrieval/verify operations. Includes rule authoring CLI, doctor --fix, --verbose/--full flags, PRAGMA config wiring, --no-gitignore on init, gitignore modification.

Benchmark and eval infrastructure. Dev-only. NOT a C2 writer. Imports viewer-core, viewer-indexer, viewer-store (read-only), viewer-retrieval. Includes prompt-level eval module with optional @anthropic-ai/sdk devDependency.
